checkpoint_selection: The trainer keeps the weights with the highest validation cosine similarity, measured every 500 steps on a 10% slice of the non-holdout pairs. Files named metrics_best_by_val_sim are that checkpoint. metrics_epoch_N are end-of-epoch snapshots saved for this comparison; the trainer does not select them unless that step had the best validation cosine.
note: Model weights and embedding caches are not published.
holdout: 20% of Amazon sessions or MIND users, blake2b(seed:key), same seed for training and evaluation.
aggregate: aggregate.json is the mean and min-max over seeds 0, 1, and 2 at the saved checkpoint, plus the validation-cosine peak and Amazon recall@50 by epoch.
